Title must follow Conventional Commits: type(scope): subject
e.g. feat(chat): add message pinning

Write for a human reviewer and for the person reading this in a year.
Explain intent and impact, not the diff: the diff is right below.
Remove any section that does not apply.
-->

## Summary

<!--
2-5 sentences: what this changes and why it matters.
Lead with the user-visible or architectural outcome, then the approach
if it is not obvious. Link the issue if one exists (Closes #123).
-->

## Changes

<!--
Short bullets, grouped by concern, only for what a reviewer needs to
navigate the diff. Skip mechanical fallout (renames, import updates,
generated files) and skip this section entirely for small PRs.
-->

## Screenshots

<!-- UI changes only. Before/after when relevant; mobile too if the layout is responsive. -->

## Testing

<!--
How this was verified: test suites run with results, new regression
tests and what they pin down, manual checks performed.
-->

## Notes

<!--
Only if needed: breaking changes and migration impact, follow-ups
